origin.description: Assistant synthesis of the user-directed recovered vision; implementation and economic advantage require separate evidence.
The user explicitly requires architectural choices, rejected options and reasons to survive, and requests useful harness practices be assimilated without flattening Projector into instructions.
Motivating integration evidence; not authority for Projector-specific design or claimed implementation.

payload.statement: Retain architectural decisions about patterns, libraries, platforms, boundaries and implementation strategy together with alternatives, reasons, constraints, assumptions, evidence, tradeoffs and applicable scope. Make the choice and why retrievable before affected edits and after a fresh clone. Reconsider only affected decisions when those inputs or scope change; preserve the historical influence of adopted soft preferences. New non-advisory consequences require actual linked canonical products in the same accepted transaction. Neither an old approval nor repeating existing code proves that the decision remains suitable. Unsupported or stale validity evidence stays explicit.
payload.title: Reconsider architecture when its reasons change
